main_text.p: tionem requirent, generali formula utamur:in quam tam multi casus,ut in Aquiliana formula, supplendi non sint: sed quæ generatim & indefinitè scripta, sola interpretatione contenta sit: præsertim autem post legem Velleam,quæ cum generalibus verbis conceptam formulam nobis tradiderit,ac proinde multos casus rumpendi præciderit,nobis etiam sui imitandæ exẽ-plum præbuit. Nimirum ut testator ita scribat, FILIVS HERES ESTO, SI FILIVS ME VIVO MORIATVR. TVNC QVI NEPOS MIHI POST MORTEM MEAM SVVS NASCETVR, HERES ESTO. nam etsi dictum sit, si filius moriatur, tamen propter hoc generale verbum, SVVS NASCETVR, quibuscunque casibus, siue mortis, siue deportationis, siue emancipationis, siue captiuitatis filij, nepos suus nascetur, recte institutus erit, nec te stamẽtum rumpet. quin etiam si generalius ita dicat, SI FILIVS MORIATVR, TVM QVICQVID MIHI LIBERORVM NATVM ERIT POST MORTEM: vel, QVICVNQVE NA-

page.notes: Catchword "TVS" at foot right, not repeated in text. The word "stamẽtum" is printed with a long s and a tilde over the e; read as testamentum, the tilde reading is slightly uncertain. The first line of the page carries a catchword-like break at "utamur:in", transcribed as printed. "exẽ-plum" is broken at line end with a printed hyphen.
